function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:$('item,entry').toArray().map(e=>{const x=$(e);return {url:x.find('link').first().attr('href')||x.find('link').first().text(),title:x.find('title').first().text(),publishedAt:x.find('pubDate,published,updated').first().text()};}),next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const body=$(".trans, article").first().clone();body.find('script,style,nav,header,footer,.post-nav,.subscribe-widget,.subscription-widget,.post-bottom').remove();return {title:$("h1,h2,h3").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
